project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Pickletillum has about a dozen households and no verified visitor offer within its compact boundary. Strict-boundary score verified sequentially on 2026-09-02. Drumoig Golf Hotel and its customer parking are outside the hamlet and are not transferred. The former 1732 inn was demolished in 2018 and is not a surviving attraction.
